name: Archive objects exposed
description: Expose archive objects in Exploration frontend.
why_invalid: Violates the zero-object product boundary.

name: Object media as nodes
description: Use object titles or thumbnails as conceptual nodes.
why_invalid: Confuses records with conceptual relations.

name: Object similarity core
description: Use object-to-object similarity as Exploration core logic.
why_invalid: Recreates the rejected discovery architecture.

name: Related-work recommendation
description: Return nearest-neighbor or related-work recommendations.
why_invalid: Changes inspiration into object discovery.

name: Object affinity score
description: Rank or score object pairs.
why_invalid: An affinity rename does not change object-centric semantics.

name: Curated overlap as relation
description: Interpret raw curated overlap as a design-history relation.
why_invalid: Co-membership is project metadata, not historical evidence.
enforcement_method: Policy review and no Context import

name: Context as semantic evidence
description: Reuse Context data as Exploration semantic evidence.
why_invalid: Context classifications do not establish historical relations.

name: Spacetime as semantic evidence
description: Reuse Spacetime data as Exploration semantic evidence.
why_invalid: Recorded place/time does not establish relation meaning.

name: Title embeddings as meaning
description: Use title embeddings as historical-semantic meaning.
why_invalid: Titles are not governed relation evidence.

name: Ungoverned subjects
description: Treat subject labels as independent historical semantics.
why_invalid: Labels require scholarly governance and qualification.

name: Source narrative as description
description: Treat provider narrative as object description.
why_invalid: Provider/source prose can describe collections or institutions.

name: Generic embedding as research model
description: Accept a generic pretrained embedding model as a research model.
why_invalid: Generic similarity does not validate the relation construct.

name: Benchmark-popular LLM/SLM
description: Accept a generic LLM or SLM because it is popular on benchmarks.
why_invalid: Popularity is not construct validity.

name: Premature vector database
description: Introduce a vector database before a valid semantic construct exists.
why_invalid: Infrastructure would entrench invalid semantics.

name: Object clustering as discovery
description: Present archive-object clustering as historical discovery.
why_invalid: Statistical grouping is not historical evidence.

name: Invalid probability score
description: Publish a probability-like relation score without a validated probabilistic model.
why_invalid: The number would have no calibrated interpretation.

name: Generated flow as history
description: Present a generated Flow as documented history.
why_invalid: Composition is not evidence.

name: Visual proximity as history
description: Interpret visual proximity as historical proximity.
why_invalid: Layout geometry is not historical evidence.

name: Distance as strength
description: Interpret screen distance as relation strength.
why_invalid: Screen position is mutable layout state.

name: Image/PNG confusion
description: Confuse immutable ExplorationImage with a rendered PNG.
why_invalid: Image is a compiled structural definition; PNG is flattened output.

name: Container mutates Image
description: Let Container edits mutate an immutable Image definition.
why_invalid: Breaks reproducibility and base-image identity.

name: PNG as source of truth
description: Treat RenderedPng as semantic source of truth.
why_invalid: Flattened pixels cannot reconstruct structured state.

name: Invented vocabulary
description: Invent relation vocabulary without design-history scholarship.
why_invalid: Labels would lack scholarly basis and governance.

name: Model-generated vocabulary
description: Let an external model produce relation vocabulary without scholarly validation.
why_invalid: Statistical generation is not historiographic governance.

name: Generated labels as evidence
description: Treat generated relation labels as evidence.
why_invalid: Generation cannot create a source or historical fact.

name: Concept-to-object recommendations
description: Offer related objects from a conceptual node.
why_invalid: Violates zero-object exposure and product purpose.

name: Hidden archive identifiers
description: Store archive identifiers invisibly in conceptual PNG or Container payloads.
why_invalid: Hidden metadata still exposes and couples records.

name: Availability-driven fusion
description: Fuse Context, Spacetime, and object data merely because available.
why_invalid: Availability is not methodological validity.

name: Affinity rename
description: Rename similarity as affinity without changing object-centric architecture.
why_invalid: Terminology does not cure the invalid construct.

name: Silent claim promotion
description: Silently promote a human inspiration flow to historical claim.
why_invalid: User composition is not scholarly evidence.
